اختاره زعماء المدينة: The leaders of Madinah chose it
بقرعة بين الصحابة: By drawing lots among the Companions
أشار إليه جبريل بالنهار: Jibril pointed it out in the daytime
He ﷺ said: Let her go, for she is under command.
لمن كانت أرض المسجد النبوي في الأصل؟: Who originally owned the land of the Prophet's Mosque?
لغلامين يتيمين فاشتراها النبي ﷺ: Two orphan boys, and the Prophet ﷺ bought it
The Prophet ﷺ paid its price and did not take it unjustly.
مما بُني المسجد النبوي أول مرة؟: What was the Prophet's Mosque first built from?
كان بسيطًا لكنه مركز العبادة والعلم والح: It was simple, yet it was the center of worship, knowledge and governance.
من شارك الصحابة في بناء المسجد؟: Who took part with the Companions in building the mosque?
He carried bricks along with them.
من الصحابي الذي نزل النبي ﷺ عنده أول ما: At which Companion's house did the Prophet ﷺ first stay when he arrived in Madinah?
نزل في بيته حتى بُني المسجد وحجرات النبي: He stayed at his house until the mosque and the Prophet's ﷺ rooms were built.
ما المؤاخاة التي أقامها النبي ﷺ؟: What was the brotherhood (Mu'akhah) that the Prophet ﷺ established?
جعل بين كل مهاجر وأنصاري أخوة: He made each Muhajir and each Ansari brothers
اتفاق تجاري مع اليهود: A trade agreement with the Jews
فقوي المجتمع الجديد وحُلّت مشكلة السكن و: So the new community grew strong, and the problems of housing and livelihood were solved.
من الأخوان المشهوران في المؤاخاة؟: Which two brothers are the famous pair in the brotherhood?
عبد الرحمن بن عوف وسعد بن الربيع: Abdur-Rahman ibn Awf and Sa'd ibn ar-Rabi'
عرض سعد على أخيه نصف ماله فقال: بارك الل: Sa'd offered his brother half his wealth, and he said: May Allah bless you; just show me the market.
ماذا نظّمت وثيقة المدينة؟: What did the Charter of Madinah regulate?
العلاقة بين المسلمين وغيرهم من سكان المد: The relationship between Muslims and other residents of Madinah, and their rights and duties
توزيع الغنائم بعد القتال: The distribution of spoils after fighting
أسعار السلع في السوق: Prices of goods in the market
أقرّت التعاون على الدفاع عن المدينة وحري: It affirmed cooperation in defending Madinah and freedom of religion.
رتّب أحداث بناء المجتمع المدني: Put the events of building the civil community in order
بروك الناقة في موضع المسجد: The camel kneeling at the site of the mosque
المؤاخاة بين المهاجرين والأنصار: The brotherhood between the Muhajirun and the Ansar
قامت دولة الإسلام على المسجد والأخوة وال: The state of Islam was founded on the mosque, brotherhood and covenant.
تحويل القبلة والأذان: The Change of the Qibla and the Adhan
إلى أي جهة صلّى المسلمون أول الأمر؟: Which direction did the Muslims first pray toward?
The Prophet ﷺ prayed toward it in Makkah and for a period after the Hijrah.
كم مدة الصلاة نحو بيت المقدس بعد الهجرة: About how long did they pray toward Jerusalem after the Hijrah?
Then he was commanded to face the Ka'bah.
إلى أي جهة حُوّلت القبلة؟: Toward which direction was the Qibla changed?
الكعبة المشرفة في المسجد الحرام: The Noble Ka'bah in the Sacred Mosque
The Prophet ﷺ loved for it to be changed toward it.
ماذا يُسمّى المسجد الذي صُلّيت فيه صلاة: What is the mosque called where a prayer was performed facing two Qiblas?
They turned toward the Ka'bah while in prayer.
في أي سورة جاء الأمر بالتوجه نحو المسجد: In which Surah was the command to face the Sacred Mosque revealed?
﴿فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْ: "So turn your face toward al-Masjid al-Haram."
ما من حكم تحويل القبلة؟: What is the wisdom behind changing the Qibla?
اختبار طاعة المؤمنين وتمييز من يتبع الرس: Testing the believers' obedience and telling who follows the Messenger ﷺ
It showed the sincere believer apart from the hesitant one.
كيف بدأ الأذان بحسب الرواية المشهورة؟: How did the Adhan begin, according to the well-known narration?
برؤيا عبد الله بن زيد وأقرّها النبي ﷺ: Through the dream of Abdullah ibn Zayd, which the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ approved
بإنزال القرآن لفظه: By the Qur'an revealing its words
باقتراح أهل الكتاب: By a suggestion from the People of the Book
The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said: "It is a true dream, if Allah wills."
من أول من أذّن للمسلمين في المدينة؟: Who was among the first to call the Adhan for the Muslims in Madinah?
من المؤذن الآخر الأعمى الذي كان يؤذن للن: Who was the other blind muezzin who gave the Adhan for the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ?
The two gave two successive Adhans in Ramadan.
رتّب هذه الأحداث بعد الهجرة: Put these events in order after the Hijrah
مشروعية الأذان: The Adhan becomes part of Islamic law
تحويل القبلة إلى الكعبة: The Qibla changes to the Kaaba
الأذان في السنة الأولى، وتحويل القبلة وب: The Adhan was in the first year; the change of the Qibla and Badr in the second.
الصحابة الذين تركوا مكة ديارهم وأموالهم: Companions who left their homes and wealth in Makkah for their religion
They left, fleeing with their faith to Allah and His Messenger.
أهل المدينة الذين آووا الرسول ﷺ ونصروه: The people of Madinah who sheltered the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and supported him
Allah named them this because they supported Islam.
في أي سورة وُصف حب الأنصار للمهاجرين؟: In which Surah is the Ansar's love for the Muhajirun described?
"They love those who emigrated to them."
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ عن حب الأنصار؟: What did the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ say about loving the Ansar?
آية الإيمان حب الأنصار: Loving the Ansar is a sign of faith
هم أفضل من المهاجرين: They are better than the Muhajirun
حبهم عادة اجتماعية: Loving them is a social habit
ماذا عرض الأنصار على إخوانهم المهاجرين؟: What did the Ansar offer their Muhajirun brothers?
قال المهاجرون: يا رسول الله ما رأينا مثل: The Muhajirun said: "O Messenger of Allah, we have never seen a people like those we came to."
من الأنصاري الذي آثر ضيف النبي ﷺ على أهل: Which Ansari preferred the guest of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ over his own family?
أبو طلحة الأنصاري وزوجته: Abu Talhah al-Ansari and his wife
سعد بن عبادة وزوجته: Sa'd ibn Ubadah and his wife
عبد الله بن رواحة وزوجته: Abdullah ibn Rawahah and his wife
فنزل فيهم قوله تعالى: ﴿وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَل: So the words of Allah were revealed about them: "And they give preference over themselves, even though they are in need."
ماذا فعل عبد الرحمن بن عوف لما عرض عليه: What did Abdur-Rahman ibn Awf do when the Ansari offered him half his wealth?
شكره وطلب أن يدله على السوق: He thanked him and asked to be shown the market
He worked in trade until he became one of the wealthy.
ماذا فعل الإسلام بين الأوس والخزرج؟: What did Islam do between the Aws and the Khazraj?
ألّف بينهما بعد حروب طويلة: It united them after long wars
زاد الخصام بينهما: It increased the conflict between them
جعل أحدهما أميرًا على الآخر: It made one the ruler over the other
فرّقهم في البلاد: It scattered them across the lands
قال تعالى: ﴿فَأَصْبَحْتُم بِنِعْمَتِهِ إ: Allah says: "And by His favor you became brothers."
رتّب قصة عبد الرحمن بن عوف في المدينة: Put the story of Abdur-Rahman ibn Awf in Madinah in order
المؤاخاة مع سعد بن الربيع: The brotherhood pact with Sa'd ibn ar-Rabi'
طلب الدلالة على السوق: He asked to be shown the market
An example of the generosity of the Ansar and the dignity of the Muhajirun.
ما أبرز قيمة جمعت الأنصار والمهاجرين؟: What is the greatest value that united the Ansar and the Muhajirun?
قال تعالى: ﴿إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْ: Allah says: "The believers are but brothers."
السيرة: الغزوات والفتح: Seerah: The Battles and the Conquest
من بدر إلى حجة الوداع: From Badr to the Farewell Pilgrimage
في أي سنة هجرية كانت غزوة بدر؟: In which Hijri year was the Battle of Badr?
It took place in the month of Ramadan.
في أي شهر وقعت غزوة بدر؟: In which month did the Battle of Badr take place?
That is why it is mentioned in the context of fasting.
كم كان عدد المسلمين تقريبًا في بدر؟: About how many Muslims were at Badr?
نحو ثلاثمائة وبضعة عشر: About three hundred and some ten
They were few, with little weaponry and few mounts.
كم كان عدد المشركين تقريبًا؟: About how many polytheists were there?
They had plenty of weapons and equipment.
لماذا خرج المسلمون أولًا؟: Why did the Muslims first set out?
لاعتراض قافلة قريش التجارية: To intercept the Quraysh trade caravan
But Allah willed that they meet the army, not the caravan.
من قال للنبي ﷺ: لا نقول كما قالت بنو إسر: Who said to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ: "We will not say as the Children of Israel said to Moses, but go and fight, and we are with you"?
The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was pleased with his words.
بماذا ذكر الله إمداد المسلمين في بدر؟: How did Allah mention supporting the Muslims at Badr?
ببرد شديد على العدو: With severe cold on the enemy
﴿أَنِّي مُمِدُّكُم بِأَلْفٍ مِّنَ الْمَل: "I will reinforce you with a thousand angels, following one after another."
ماذا سُمّي يوم بدر في القرآن؟: What is the day of Badr called in the Qur'an?
﴿يَوْمَ الْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْ: "The Day of Criterion, the day when the two armies met."
من أبرز زعماء قريش الذين قُتلوا في بدر؟: Which prominent Quraysh leader was killed at Badr?
قُتل على يد معاذ ومعوذ ثم أجهز عليه ابن: He was killed by Mu'adh and Mu'awwidh, then Ibn Mas'ud finished him off.
رتّب أحداث غزوة بدر: Put the events of the Battle of Badr in order
الخروج لاعتراض القافلة: Setting out to intercept the caravan
It was the first great victory for the Muslims.
في أي سنة هجرية وقعت غزوة أحد؟: In which Hijri year did the Battle of Uhud take place?
Quraysh came to take revenge for their defeat at Badr.
من قائد الرماة في أحد؟: Who was the commander of the archers at Uhud?
وضعهم النبي ﷺ على الجبل لحماية ظهور المس: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ placed them on the mountain to protect the Muslims' rear.
ماذا أمر النبي ﷺ الرماة؟: What did the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ command the archers?
ألا يتركوا أماكنهم مهما حدث: Not to leave their positions no matter what happened
أن ينزلوا فور بدء القتال: To come down as soon as the fighting began
Even if they saw the Muslims being defeated or winning.
لماذا تغيّرت نتيجة المعركة بعد النصر الأ: Why did the result of the battle change after the first victory?
لأن أكثر الرماة تركوا أماكنهم طمعًا في ا: Because most archers left their positions out of desire for the spoils
لنفاد سلاح المسلمين: Because the Muslims ran out of weapons
لأن النبي ﷺ ترك المعركة: Because the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ left the battle
So the polytheists circled around from behind the mountain.
من قاد فرسان قريش حين التفوا على المسلمي: Who led the Quraysh cavalry when they circled around the Muslims?
خالد بن الوليد قبل أن يسلم: Khalid ibn al-Walid, before he became Muslim
ثم أسلم خالد بعد ذلك وصار سيف الله المسل: Khalid later accepted Islam and became the Drawn Sword of Allah.
من عمّ النبي ﷺ الذي استشهد في أحد؟: Which uncle of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was martyred at Uhud?
He was nicknamed the Lion of Allah and the Master of the Martyrs.
ماذا أصاب النبي ﷺ في أحد؟: What happened to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ at Uhud?
كُسرت رباعيته وشُجّ وجهه: His front tooth was broken and his face was wounded
He ﷺ stood firm and the Companions defended him.
من حامل لواء المسلمين الذي استشهد في أحد: Who was the Muslims' standard-bearer who was martyred at Uhud?
He stood firm until he was martyred, may Allah be pleased with him.
ما الدرس الأبرز من غزوة أحد؟: What is the greatest lesson from the Battle of Uhud?
خطر مخالفة أمر القائد وحب الدنيا: The danger of disobeying the leader's order and loving worldly gain
أن القتال بلا تخطيط يكفي: That fighting without planning is enough
أن النصر لا يرتبط بالطاعة: That victory is not linked to obedience
قال تعالى: ﴿أَوَلَمَّا أَصَابَتْكُم مُّص: Allah says: "Why, when a disaster struck you, although you had struck twice as much..."
رتّب أحداث غزوة أحد: Put the events of the Battle of Uhud in order
خروج المسلمين وتنظيم الصفوف: The Muslims set out and arrange the ranks
النصر في أول القتال: Victory at the start of the fighting
التفاف الفرسان على المسلمين: The cavalry circles around the Muslims
ثبات النبي ﷺ وأصحابه: The steadfastness of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and his Companions
Then the polytheists withdrew and did not enter Madinah.
في أي سنة هجرية وقعت غزوة الخندق؟: In which Hijri year did the Battle of the Trench take place?
It is also called the Battle of the Confederates.
كانت فكرة جديدة على العرب أخذها سلمان من: It was a new idea to the Arabs that Salman brought from Persia.
لماذا سُميت غزوة الأحزاب بهذا الاسم؟: Why was the Battle of the Confederates given this name?
لتحزّب قبائل ومجموعات على حرب المسلمين: Because tribes and groups allied to fight the Muslims
لأنها حدثت في موسم الحج: Because it happened in the Hajj season
لأنها بين الأوس والخزرج: Because it was between the Aws and the Khazraj
Quraysh, Ghatafan and their allies gathered.
كيف شارك النبي ﷺ في حفر الخندق؟: How did the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ take part in digging the trench?
حفر مع الصحابة وتحمّل معهم الجوع والتعب: He dug with the Companions and bore hunger and fatigue with them
سافر ولم يشهد الحفر: He traveled and did not see the digging
ترك الأمر لسلمان وحده: He left it to Salman alone
ربط الصحابة حجرًا على بطونه من الجوع ورب: The Companions tied one stone on their bellies from hunger, and the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ tied two.
ماذا فعل بنو قريظة أثناء الحصار؟: What did Banu Qurayzah do during the siege?
نقضوا العهد مع النبي ﷺ: They broke the treaty with the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
So the danger to the Muslims grew.
من الصحابي الذي خذّل بين الأحزاب بحكمته؟: Which Companion wisely caused division among the confederates?
كان قد أسلم وقومه لا يعلمون فبثّ الشك بي: He had accepted Islam without his people knowing, so he spread doubt among them.
كيف نصر الله المسلمين في الخندق؟: How did Allah grant victory to the Muslims at the Trench?
بريح شديدة وجنود لم يروها: With a violent wind and soldiers they could not see
بانهيار الخندق: With the collapse of the trench
﴿فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُو: "So We sent upon them a wind and armies you did not see."
في أي سورة وردت أحداث الأحزاب؟: In which Surah are the events of the Confederates mentioned?
It mentioned the fear and the steadfastness of the believers.
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ بعد انصراف الأحزاب؟: What did the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ say after the confederates left?
الآن نغزوهم ولا يغزوننا: "Now we will march against them, and they will not march against us."
أي أن الجهة التي كانت ضعيفة تحوّلت إلى ج: That is, the side that had been weak became the one taking the initiative.
رتّب أحداث غزوة الخندق: Put the events of the Battle of the Trench in order
إرسال الريح على الأحزاب: The wind is sent upon the confederates
The siege ended with a victory from Allah without major fighting.
The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ set out in it for Umrah.
ما هدف خروج النبي ﷺ إلى مكة؟: What was the aim of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in going to Makkah?
They brought sacrificial animals and entered the state of Ihram for Umrah.
كم كان عدد المسلمين تقريبًا في الحديبية؟: About how many Muslims were at Hudaybiyyah?
The Companions mentioned this in authentic narrations.
من أرسله النبي ﷺ سفيرًا إلى قريش؟: Whom did the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ send as an envoy to Quraysh?
When news spread that he had been killed, the Companions pledged to fight.
أين كانت بيعة الرضوان؟: Where was the Pledge of Ridwan?
﴿لَقَدْ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِي: "Certainly was Allah pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you under the tree."
من ممثل قريش في كتابة الصلح؟: Who was Quraysh's representative in writing the treaty?
He insisted on terms that seemed harsh on the surface.
كم مدة الهدنة التي اتفقوا عليها؟: How long was the truce they agreed on?
Then Quraysh broke it before it ended.
ما أحد شروط الصلح؟: What was one of the terms of the treaty?
أن يرجع المسلمون هذا العام ويعتمروا في ا: That the Muslims return this year and perform Umrah the next year
أن يدفعوا مالًا لقريش: That they pay money to Quraysh
The Prophet ﷺ accepted the terms in search of peace.
ماذا سمّى الله صلح الحديبية؟: What did Allah call the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah?
﴿إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُّبِينًا: “Indeed, We have given you, [O Muhammad], a clear conquest.”
رتّب أحداث صلح الحديبية: Put the events of the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah in order
التحلل والعودة إلى المدينة: Leaving ihram and returning to Medina
It was followed by a great spread of Islam.
حصون لليهود شمال المدينة غزاها النبي ﷺ: Fortresses of the Jews north of Medina, which the Prophet ﷺ attacked
He attacked it after Hudaybiyyah, in the seventh year.
من الذي فتح الله على يديه حصنًا بعد أن أ: Who was the man at whose hands Allah granted the conquest of a fortress after the Prophet ﷺ gave him the banner at Khaybar?
قال ﷺ: لأعطين الراية رجلًا يحب الله ورسو: He ﷺ said: I will give the banner to a man who loves Allah and His Messenger.
مع من كانت معركة مؤتة؟: Who was the battle of Mu'tah against?
It took place in the eighth year after the Hijrah.
من أول أمراء جيش مؤتة؟: Who was the first commander of the army of Mu'tah?
Then Ja'far, then Ibn Rawahah, and they were all martyred.
من الذي أخذ الراية وأحسن الانسحاب في مؤت: Who took the banner and led a skillful withdrawal at Mu'tah?
The Prophet ﷺ said of him: A sword among the swords of Allah.
ما آخر غزوة غزاها النبي ﷺ بنفسه؟: What was the last expedition the Prophet ﷺ led himself?
It was in the ninth year after the Hijrah.
بماذا سُمّي جيش تبوك؟: What was the army of Tabuk called?
Because of the intense heat and the shortage of supplies and money.
من جهّز جزءًا كبيرًا من جيش العسرة بماله: Who equipped a large part of the Army of Hardship with his own wealth?
فقال النبي ﷺ: ما ضرّ عثمان ما عمل بعد ال: The Prophet ﷺ said: Nothing Uthman does after today will harm him.
من الثلاثة الذين خُلّفوا عن غزوة تبوك ثم: Who were the three who stayed behind from the expedition of Tabuk, and whose repentance Allah then accepted?
كعب بن مالك ومرارة بن الربيع وهلال بن أم: Ka'b ibn Malik, Murarah ibn al-Rabi' and Hilal ibn Umayyah
أبو لبابة وأبو ذر وسلمان: Abu Lubabah, Abu Dharr and Salman
كعب بن مالك وخالد بن الوليد وعمار: Ka'b ibn Malik, Khalid ibn al-Walid and Ammar
They held firm to the truth, so their repentance was accepted.
رتّب هذه الأحداث من الأقدم إلى الأحدث: Put these events in order from earliest to latest
خيبر في 7هـ ومؤتة وفتح مكة في 8هـ وتبوك: Khaybar in 7 AH, Mu'tah and the Conquest of Mecca in 8 AH, and Tabuk in 9 AH.
It took place in the month of Ramadan.
ما سبب خروج النبي ﷺ لفتح مكة؟: Why did the Prophet ﷺ set out for the Conquest of Mecca?
نقض قريش صلح الحديبية: Quraysh broke the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah
طلب أهل مكة: A request from the people of Mecca
أعانوا حلفاءهم بني بكر على خزاعة حلفاء ا: They helped their allies, Banu Bakr, against Khuza'ah, the allies of the Muslims.
كم كان عدد جيش المسلمين تقريبًا؟: About how large was the Muslim army?
It was the largest Muslim army up to that time.
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ عن دار أبي سفيان؟: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about the house of Abu Sufyan?
إنها أول ما يُفتح: That it is the first thing to be conquered
The Prophet ﷺ honored Abu Sufyan after he accepted Islam.
كيف دخل النبي ﷺ مكة؟: How did the Prophet ﷺ enter Mecca?
متواضعًا خاشعًا على راحلته: Humble and submissive on his mount
على فرس حربية معلنًا الانتقام: On a war horse, declaring revenge
So much so that his head almost touched his saddle, in gratitude to Allah.
ماذا فعل النبي ﷺ بالأصنام حول الكعبة؟: What did the Prophet ﷺ do with the idols around the Kaaba?
كسّرها وهو يتلو آية جاء الحق وزهق الباطل: He broke them while reciting the verse: Truth has come and falsehood has departed
تركها كما هي: He left them as they were
أمر ببيعها: He ordered them to be sold
“Truth has come, and falsehood has departed.”
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ لقريش حين قدر عليهم؟: What did the Prophet ﷺ say to Quraysh when he gained power over them?
عليكم دفع جزية ثقيلة: You must pay a heavy tax
He forgave them out of mercy, and most of them became Muslim.
من أذّن على ظهر الكعبة يوم الفتح؟: Who gave the call to prayer from the roof of the Kaaba on the day of the Conquest?
So victory came to those who had once been oppressed.
لمن أُعيد مفتاح الكعبة بعد الفتح؟: To whom was the key of the Kaaba returned after the Conquest?
Allah commanded that trusts be returned to their rightful owners.
رتّب أحداث فتح مكة: Put the events of the Conquest of Mecca in order
تحطيم الأصنام والعفو العام: Destroying the idols and the general amnesty
Mecca was conquered without major fighting.
حجة الوداع ووفاة النبي ﷺ: The Farewell Pilgrimage and the death of the Prophet ﷺ
في أي سنة هجرية كانت حجة الوداع؟: In which year after the Hijrah was the Farewell Pilgrimage?
وهي الحجة الوحيدة التي حجّها النبي ﷺ بعد: It was the only Hajj the Prophet ﷺ performed after the Hijrah.
أين خطب النبي ﷺ خطبته الكبرى في الحج؟: Where did the Prophet ﷺ give his great sermon during Hajj?
خطب في بطن وادي عرنة ثم صلى الظهر والعصر: He spoke in the valley of Uranah, then prayed Dhuhr and Asr.
ما الآية التي نزلت في حجة الوداع؟: Which verse was revealed during the Farewell Pilgrimage?
﴿الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ﴾: “This day I have perfected for you your religion.”
﴿اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ﴾: “Recite in the name of your Lord.”
It is among the last verses revealed.
بماذا أوصى النبي ﷺ أمته في خطبة الوداع؟: What did the Prophet ﷺ advise his Ummah in the Farewell Sermon?
بالتمسك بكتاب الله: To hold firmly to the Book of Allah
قال: تركت فيكم ما لن تضلوا بعده إن اعتصم: He said: I have left among you that which, if you hold fast to it, you will never go astray: the Book of Allah.
ماذا أكد النبي ﷺ في خطبته عن الدماء والأ: What did the Prophet ﷺ stress in his sermon about blood and property?
أنها محرمة كحرمة اليوم والشهر والبلد: That they are sacred, like the sacredness of this day, month and land
أنها مباحة للقبائل: That they are permitted among the tribes
أنها للأقوى: That they belong to the strongest
He said: Your blood and your property are sacred to one another.
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ عن مناسك الحج؟: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about the rites of Hajj?
اتركوا منها ما شئتم: Leave out of them whatever you wish
For he is the example in worship.
في أي سنة هجرية توفي النبي ﷺ؟: In which year after the Hijrah did the Prophet ﷺ pass away?
He passed away in the month of Rabi' al-Awwal.
أين دُفن النبي ﷺ؟: Where was the Prophet ﷺ buried?
He died in his home and was buried where he passed away.
من الذي أمره النبي ﷺ بإمامة الصلاة في مر: Whom did the Prophet ﷺ instruct to lead the prayer during his illness?
That was an indication of his standing.
رتّب أحداث أواخر حياة النبي ﷺ: Put the events of the last part of the Prophet's ﷺ life in order
فتح مكة 8هـ، تبوك 9هـ، حجة الوداع 10هـ،: Conquest of Mecca 8 AH, Tabuk 9 AH, Farewell Pilgrimage 10 AH, then his death in 11 AH.
شمائل النبي ﷺ وأخلاقه: The Prophet's ﷺ character and manners
خلقه وعفوه ورحمته ﷺ: His character, forgiveness and mercy ﷺ
ماذا قال الله تعالى عن خلق النبي ﷺ؟: What did Allah the Almighty say about the character of the Prophet ﷺ?
﴿وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ﴾: “And indeed, you are of a great moral character.”
﴿وَإِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾: “And indeed, you are among the messengers.”
ماذا قالت عائشة رضي الله عنها عن خلق الن: What did Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her) say about the character of the Prophet ﷺ?
Meaning that he acted by the Qur'an and followed its manners.
بماذا وصف الله رسوله ﷺ في سورة الأنبياء؟: How did Allah describe His Messenger ﷺ in Surah Al-Anbiya?
﴿وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّ: “And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.”
كيف تعامل النبي ﷺ مع أهل مكة بعد الفتح؟: How did the Prophet ﷺ treat the people of Mecca after the Conquest?
عفا عنهم رغم أذاهم السابق: He forgave them despite their earlier harm
He said: Go, for you are free.
ماذا فعل النبي ﷺ حين جذب أعرابي رداءه بق: What did the Prophet ﷺ do when a Bedouin pulled his cloak hard?
ضحك وأمر له بعطاء: He smiled and ordered a gift for him
غضب وعاقبه: He got angry and punished him
أمر بحبسه: He ordered him to be jailed
أعرض ولم يجب: He turned away and did not answer
متى كان النبي ﷺ يغضب كما تقول عائشة؟: When did the Prophet ﷺ become angry, according to Aisha?
إذا انتُهكت حرمات الله: When the sacred limits of Allah were violated
إذا تأخر عنه أحد: When someone was late to him
إذا خالفه أحد في الرأي: When someone disagreed with his opinion
إذا سُئل عن شيء: When he was asked about something
ما انتقم لنفسه قط إلا أن تُنتهك حرمة الل: He never took revenge for himself, unless the sacred limits of Allah were violated.
ماذا فعل النبي ﷺ مع الغلام اليهودي المري: What did the Prophet ﷺ do with the sick Jewish boy?
زاره في مرضه ودعاه إلى الإسلام فأسلم: He visited him in his illness and invited him to Islam, and he accepted
أمر بعزله: He ordered him to be isolated
رواه البخاري، وقال: الحمد لله الذي أنقذه: Narrated by al-Bukhari; he said: Praise be to Allah who saved him from the Fire.
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ للصحابة حين بال أعرابي: What did the Prophet ﷺ say to the Companions when a Bedouin urinated in the mosque?
دعوه ثم أمر بصبّ ماء على بوله: Leave him, then he ordered water poured over the urine
Then he taught him gently afterwards.
ما الغاية من بعثته ﷺ كما قال عن نفسه؟: What was the purpose of his mission ﷺ, as he said about himself?
إنما بُعثت لأتمم صالح الأخلاق: I was only sent to perfect good character
قال النبي ﷺ: «إن من خياركم أحسنكم …»: The Prophet ﷺ said: “The best of you are those who are best in …”
معاملته للأطفال والأهل والخدم: His treatment of children, family and servants
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ حين رأى الأقرع بن حابس: What did the Prophet ﷺ say when he saw al-Aqra' ibn Habis surprised that he kissed al-Hasan?
من لا يرحم لا يُرحم: Whoever shows no mercy will be shown no mercy
هذا ضعف لا يليق: That is a weakness that is not fitting
لا تفعلوا ذلك أمام الناس: Do not do that in front of people
ماذا كان يفعل النبي ﷺ مع أمامة بنت زينب: What did the Prophet ﷺ do with Umamah, the daughter of Zaynab, during prayer?
يحملها إذا قام ويضعها إذا سجد: He carried her when he stood and put her down when he prostrated
يطردها من المسجد: He drove her out of the mosque
يربطها بعيدًا: He tied her up far away
لا يسمح لها بالدخول: He did not allow her to enter
كم سنة خدم أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه النب: How many years did Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him) serve the Prophet ﷺ?
Anas said: He never once said “uff” to me.
ماذا قال أنس عن معاملة النبي ﷺ له؟: What did Anas say about how the Prophet ﷺ treated him?
ما قال لي لشيء فعلته لِمَ فعلته: He never said to me about something I did, “Why did you do it?”
ماذا قالت عائشة عن ضرب النبي ﷺ لخادم أو: What did Aisha say about the Prophet ﷺ hitting a servant or a woman?
ما ضرب بيده خادمًا ولا امرأة قط: He never struck a servant or a woman with his hand
ماذا كان النبي ﷺ يفعل في بيته؟: What did the Prophet ﷺ do at home?
يخدم أهله ويخيط ثوبه ويخصف نعله: He served his family, sewed his clothes and mended his sandals
He would be helping his family, and when the prayer time came, he went out.
قال النبي ﷺ: «خيركم خيركم …»: The Prophet ﷺ said: “The best of you are the best to …”
Then he said: And I am the best of you to my family. Narrated by at-Tirmidhi.
ماذا فعل النبي ﷺ مع عائشة رضي الله عنها: What did the Prophet ﷺ do with Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her) out of affection?
منعها من الخروج: He prevented her from going out
لم يكلمها: He did not speak to her
Narrated by Abu Dawud and others with a sound chain.
ماذا كان النبي ﷺ يفعل إذا مرّ بصبيان؟: What did the Prophet ﷺ do when he passed by children?
يطلب منهم الابتعاد: He told them to go away
ماذا فعل النبي ﷺ إذا سمع بكاء صبي أثناء: What did the Prophet ﷺ do when he heard a child crying during prayer?
قطعها وانصرف: He cut it short and left
طلب إخراج الصبي: He asked for the boy to be taken out
قال: إني لأدخل في الصلاة وأنا أريد إطالت: He said: "I begin the prayer intending to make it long, but then I hear a child crying, so I shorten it."
ماذا كان فراش النبي ﷺ في بيته؟: What was the Prophet's ﷺ bed at home?
حصير يؤثر في جنبه أحيانًا: A mat that sometimes left marks on his side
Umar said: "I saw the marks of the mat on his side ﷺ."
ما أكثر ما كان يأكله النبي ﷺ؟: What did the Prophet ﷺ eat most often?
قالت عائشة: كان يمر الهلال والهلال ولا ي: Aisha said: "One crescent after another would pass, and no fire was lit in his home."
ماذا حدث لدرع النبي ﷺ عند وفاته؟: What happened to the Prophet's ﷺ armor when he passed away?
كانت مرهونة عند يهودي بشعير: It was pawned to a Jewish man for barley
كانت مدفونة في قبره: It was buried in his grave
كان قد أهداها لقريش: He had given it as a gift to Quraysh
ماذا ترك النبي ﷺ من مال بعد وفاته؟: What wealth did the Prophet ﷺ leave after his death?
بغلته وسلاحه وأرضًا جعلها صدقة: His mule, his weapons, and land he made charity
He left neither a dinar nor a dirham.
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ: «لا تُطروني كما أطرت …: What did the Prophet ﷺ say: "Do not praise me excessively as … praised …"
النصارى ابن مريم: The Christians - the son of Mary
وقال: إنما أنا عبد فقولوا عبد الله ورسول: He said: "I am only a servant, so say: the servant of Allah and His Messenger."
ماذا كان النبي ﷺ يفعل في خدمة نفسه؟: What did the Prophet ﷺ do to serve himself?
يخيط ثوبه ويحلب شاته ويخدم نفسه: He mended his clothes, milked his sheep, and served himself
ينتظر من يخدمه دائمًا: He always waited for someone to serve him
لا يعمل بيده: He did not work with his hands
يطلب من الصحابة كل شيء: He asked the Companions for everything
He was a human being like any other: he checked his clothes for lice and milked his sheep.
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ عن الدعوة من الفقير؟: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about an invitation from a poor person?
لو دُعيت إلى ذراع أو كراع لأجبت: "If I were invited to a forearm or a trotter, I would accept"
أجيب ذوي الولائم فقط: "I accept only those who host feasts"
كيف شبّه النبي ﷺ حاله مع الدنيا؟: How did the Prophet ﷺ describe his relationship with this world?
كراكب استظل تحت شجرة ثم راح وتركها: Like a traveler who rests in the shade of a tree, then leaves it behind
كملك على عرشه: Like a king on his throne
كيف كان النبي ﷺ يتنقل أحيانًا؟: How did the Prophet ﷺ sometimes travel?
يركب الحمار ويُردف خلفه: He rode a donkey and let someone ride behind him
يركب محمولًا على الأكتاف: He was carried on people's shoulders
This was out of his humility ﷺ.
ما أبرز صفة تجمع بين الزهد والتواضع؟: Which main quality joins simplicity and humility?
القناعة وعدم التعلق بالدنيا: Contentment and not being attached to this world
He ﷺ gave like someone who does not fear poverty.
عبادته وقيامه ﷺ: His Worship and Night Prayer ﷺ
ماذا حدث لقدمي النبي ﷺ من كثرة القيام؟: What happened to the Prophet's ﷺ feet from standing in prayer so much?
أصابهما البرد: They were hit by the cold
قال: أفلا أكون عبدًا شكورًا؟ رواه البخار: He said: "Should I not be a grateful servant?" Narrated by Bukhari and Muslim.
ما أفضل وقت لقيام الليل كان النبي ﷺ يحرص: What was the best time for the night prayer that the Prophet ﷺ was keen on?
آخر الليل: The last part of the night
ينزل ربنا إلى السماء الدنيا في الثلث الأ: Our Lord descends to the lowest heaven in the last third of the night.
كم ركعة كان النبي ﷺ يصلي غالبًا من الليل: How many rak'ahs did the Prophet ﷺ usually pray at night?
لا يصلي من الليل: He did not pray at night
قالت عائشة: ما كان يزيد في رمضان ولا في: Aisha said: "He would not exceed eleven rak'ahs, in Ramadan or at any other time."
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ عن الصلاة؟: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about prayer?
جُعلت قرة عيني في الصلاة: "The coolness of my eyes was made in prayer"
Narrated by an-Nasa'i with a sound chain.
أي يومين كان النبي ﷺ يحرص على صيامهما؟: Which two days did the Prophet ﷺ make a point of fasting?
He said: "Deeds are presented on Monday and Thursday."
كم مرة كان النبي ﷺ يستغفر في اليوم؟: How many times a day did the Prophet ﷺ seek forgiveness?
قال: إني لأستغفر الله في اليوم أكثر من س: He said: "I seek Allah's forgiveness more than seventy times a day." Narrated by Bukhari.
ماذا كان يفعل في العشر الأواخر من رمضان؟: What did he do in the last ten nights of Ramadan?
يعتكف ويحيي الليل: He stayed in the mosque and spent the nights in worship
يخرج للقتال دائمًا: He always went out to fight
He would wake his family and tighten his waist-wrapper.
كيف كان النبي ﷺ يقرأ القرآن؟: How did the Prophet ﷺ recite the Qur'an?
بصوت منخفض جدًّا لا يُسمع: Very quietly, so it could not be heard
قال تعالى: ﴿وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِي: Allah says: "And recite the Qur'an with measured recitation."
في أي سورة جاء الأمر بقيام الليل ﴿قُمِ ا: In which Surah does the command for night prayer come: "Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little"?
It was among the first to be revealed.
رتّب ليلة النبي ﷺ المعتادة: Put the Prophet's ﷺ usual night in order
القيام في آخر الليل: Praying at the end of the night
الخروج لصلاة الفجر: Going out for the Fajr prayer
قصص الأنبياء في القرآن: Stories of the Prophets in the Qur'an
من أي شيء خلق الله آدم عليه السلام؟: What did Allah create Adam (peace be upon him) from?
Allah created Adam from clay, and created Iblis from fire.
ماذا أمر الله الملائكة بعد خلق آدم؟: What did Allah command the angels after creating Adam?
سجدت الملائكة امتثالًا لأمر الله إلا إبل: The angels prostrated in obedience to Allah's command, except Iblis.
من الذي رفض السجود لآدم؟: Who refused to prostrate to Adam?
رفض إبليس تكبّرًا وقال إنه خير من آدم لأ: Iblis refused out of arrogance and said he was better than Adam because he was created from fire.
ما الذي أدّى بإبليس إلى رفض السجود؟: What led Iblis to refuse to prostrate?
الكِبر أول ذنب عُصي به الله، ولذلك طُرد: Arrogance was the first sin by which Allah was disobeyed, so Iblis was expelled from His mercy.
بماذا فضّل الله آدم على الملائكة في المش: How did Allah favor Adam over the angels in the scene mentioned in Surah Al-Baqarah?
بتعليمه الأسماء كلها: By teaching him all the names
علّم الله آدم أسماء الأشياء فظهر فضله با: Allah taught Adam the names of things, so his virtue appeared through knowledge.
أين أسكن الله آدم وزوجه أول الأمر؟: Where did Allah first place Adam and his wife?
قال الله لهما: ﴿اسْكُنْ أَنتَ وَزَوْجُكَ: Allah said to them: "Dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise."
ماذا نهى الله آدم وزوجه عنه في الجنة؟: What did Allah forbid Adam and his wife in Paradise?
He allowed them everything and forbade them only one tree.
كيف وقع آدم وزوجه في الخطأ؟: How did Adam and his wife make the mistake?
وسوس لهما الشيطان فأكلا من الشجرة: Satan whispered to them and they ate from the tree
أكلا منها عمدًا بلا وسوسة: They ate from it on purpose, without any whispering
أكلا منها نسيانًا لا غير: They ate from it only out of forgetfulness
أغواهما الشيطان بالوسوسة، فأكلا من الشجر: Satan misled them with his whispering, so they ate from the tree.
ماذا فعل آدم بعد أن أخطأ؟: What did Adam do after he made the mistake?
تاب إلى الله فتاب عليه: He repented to Allah and Allah accepted his repentance
تلقّى آدم من ربه كلمات فتاب عليه، والله: Adam received words from his Lord and He accepted his repentance; Allah is the Accepter of Repentance, the Merciful.
رتّب أحداث قصة آدم: Put the events of Adam's story in order
Then his descendants grew on the Earth.
إلى ماذا دعا نوح قومه؟: What did Noah call his people to?
قال لهم: ﴿اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِ: He said to them: "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him."
كم لبث نوح في قومه يدعوهم؟: How long did Noah stay among his people calling them?
Allah mentioned this in Surah Al-Ankabut.
من اتّبع نوحًا في الغالب من قومه؟: Who mostly followed Noah from his people?
استهزأ الكبراء به وآمن به قلّة من الضعفا: The leaders mocked him, and only a few of the weak believed in him.
ماذا أمر الله نوحًا أن يصنع؟: What did Allah command Noah to make?
أمره الله أن يصنع الفلك، وكان القوم يسخر: Allah commanded him to build the Ark, and the people mocked him.
ماذا حمل نوح في السفينة؟: What did Noah carry on the ship?
المؤمنين وزوجين من كل نوع: The believers and a pair of every kind
أمره الله أن يحمل من كل زوجين اثنين ومن: Allah commanded him to carry two of every kind, and those who believed.
ما الذي حدث لابن نوح الذي لم يؤمن؟: What happened to Noah's son who did not believe?
غرق مع المغرقين: He drowned with those who were drowned
نجا بالجبل: He was saved by the mountain
ظنّ أن الجبل يعصمه، فقال نوح: لا عاصم ال: He thought the mountain would protect him, but Noah said: "There is no protector today from Allah's command."
ما الدرس من قصة ابن نوح؟: What is the lesson from the story of Noah's son?
النجاة بالإيمان لا بالنسب: Salvation comes through faith, not family ties
Kinship does not help someone who does not believe.
على أي جبل استقرت السفينة؟: On which mountain did the Ark come to rest?
قال تعالى: ﴿وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِ: Allah says: "And it came to rest on [Mount] Judi."
أي صفة من صفات نوح تظهر في قصته؟: Which quality of Noah appears in his story?
الصبر الطويل على الدعوة: Long patience in calling to Allah
He called his people night and day for many years.
رتّب أحداث قصة نوح: Put the events of Noah's story in order
دعوة قومه سنين طويلة: Calling his people for many years
ركوب المؤمنين وبدء الطوفان: The believers board and the Flood begins
استقرار السفينة على الجودي: The Ark comes to rest on Al-Judi
The believers were saved and the disbelievers perished.
هود وصالح عليهما السلام: Hud and Salih (peace be upon them)
إلى أي قوم أُرسل هود عليه السلام؟: To which people was Hud (peace be upon him) sent?
Ad was a great power in Al-Ahqaf.
بماذا كان قوم عاد مشهورين؟: What were the people of Ad famous for?
بالقوة وبناء الأبنية العالية: For strength and building tall structures
اغترّوا بقوتهم وقالوا: من أشد منا قوة؟: They were proud of their strength and said: "Who is stronger than us?"
بماذا أُهلك قوم عاد؟: How were the people of Ad destroyed?
سلّط الله عليهم الريح سبع ليالٍ وثمانية: Allah sent the wind against them for seven nights and eight days.
إلى أي قوم أُرسل صالح عليه السلام؟: To which people was Salih (peace be upon him) sent?
Thamud lived in Al-Hijr and carved their homes into the mountains.
ما معجزة صالح عليه السلام؟: What was the miracle of Salih (peace be upon him)?
قال لهم: ﴿هَٰذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ: He said to them: "This is the she-camel of Allah, a sign for you."
ماذا فعل قوم ثمود بالناقة؟: What did the people of Thamud do to the she-camel?
عقروا الناقة وتحدّوا نبيهم فجاءهم العذاب: They slaughtered the she-camel and defied their prophet, so the punishment came upon them.
ماذا كان القوم يتقاسمونه مع الناقة؟: What did the people share with the she-camel?
She had her day to drink, and they had their own appointed day.
ماذا كان نحت ثمود في الجبال؟: What did Thamud carve in the mountains?
Allah Almighty says they carved homes out of the mountains.
ما العبرة المشتركة بين هلاك عاد وثمود؟: What lesson do the destruction of 'Ad and Thamud share?
القوة لا تغني عن طاعة الله: Strength cannot replace obedience to Allah
They were deluded by their strength and their homes, so Allah destroyed them.
رتّب الأقوام بحسب ذكرهم في الدرس: Order the peoples as they appear in the lesson
This is the order in the lesson, not an exact chronological order.
أنكر إبراهيم عليهم عبادة ما لا يسمع ولا: Ibrahim rebuked them for worshipping what neither hears nor sees.
ماذا فعل إبراهيم بالأصنام؟: What did Ibrahim do to the idols?
كسّرها إلا كبيرًا لهم: He broke them, except the biggest one
ترك كبيرهم ليسألوه، وأراد أن يبيّن عجزها: He left their biggest one so they would ask it, and he wanted to show their helplessness.
ماذا قال إبراهيم عن الشمس والقمر والكوكب: What did Ibrahim say about the sun, moon and star when they set?
لا أحب الآفلين: I do not love those that set
He knew that the One worshipped neither disappears nor fades away.
بماذا عاقب قومه إبراهيم؟: How did his people punish Ibrahim?
ألقوه في النار: They threw him into the fire
سجنوه سنة: They jailed him for a year
قتلوه بالسيف: They killed him with a sword
They gathered wood and lit a huge fire.
ماذا قال الله للنار؟: What did Allah say to the fire?
﴿يَا نَارُ كُونِي بَرْدًا وَسَلَامًا عَل: "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim."
Allah saved him from the fire by His power.
بماذا رأى إبراهيم في المنام بعد أن رُزق: What did Ibrahim see in a dream after he was granted a son?
أنه يذبح ابنه: That he was sacrificing his son
أنه يبني قصرًا: That he was building a palace
أنه يسافر للشام: That he was traveling to Sham
The dreams of prophets are revelation, so he hurried to obey.
بماذا ردّ الابن لما أخبره أبوه برؤياه؟: How did the son respond when his father told him of the dream?
افعل ما تُؤمر ستجدني من الصابرين: Do as you are commanded; you will find me patient
هرب من أبيه: He ran away from his father
طلب تأجيل الأمر: He asked to delay the command
قال: ﴿سَتَجِدُنِي إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ: He said: "You will find me, if Allah wills, among the patient."
ماذا حدث عندما استسلما لأمر الله؟: What happened when they both submitted to Allah's command?
فداه الله بذبح عظيم: Allah ransomed him with a great sacrifice
أُمر بالذبح فعلًا: The sacrifice was actually carried out
أرسل الله ملكًا يحمل الولد: Allah sent an angel to carry the boy
It was a clear trial, and from it the Udhiyah (sacrifice) was prescribed.
قال تعالى: ﴿وَاتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ إِبْرَاهِ: Allah Almighty says: "And Allah took Ibrahim as an intimate friend."
رتّب أحداث قصة إبراهيم: Order the events of Ibrahim's story
رؤيا الذبح والفداء: The dream of sacrifice and the ransom
The ransom came after he was granted a son.
إسماعيل وبناء الكعبة: Isma'il and the building of the Kaaba
من هو والد إسماعيل عليه السلام؟: Who is the father of Isma'il (peace be upon him)?
إسماعيل هو ابن إبراهيم الأكبر، وأمه هاجر: Isma'il is Ibrahim's eldest son, and his mother is Hajar.
ثبت في صحيح البخاري أن إبراهيم تركها وول: It is authentically reported in Sahih al-Bukhari that Ibrahim left her and her son in a valley with no vegetation.
أين تُرك إسماعيل وأمه بأمر الله؟: Where were Isma'il and his mother left, by Allah's command?
قال إبراهيم: ﴿رَبَّنَا إِنِّي أَسْكَنتُ: Ibrahim said: "Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in a valley without cultivation."
ما البئر التي فجّرها الله لهما؟: Which well did Allah cause to gush forth for them?
جاء في الحديث الصحيح أن الله فجّر لهما ز: The authentic Hadith says Allah made Zamzam gush forth for them.
ماذا فعلت هاجر بين الصفا والمروة؟: What did Hajar do between Safa and Marwa?
سعت تبحث عن الماء: She ran back and forth looking for water
From this, the Sa'y was prescribed in Hajj and Umrah.
ماذا قال إبراهيم وإسماعيل وهما يبنيان؟: What did Ibrahim and Isma'il say as they built?
ربنا تقبّل منا: Our Lord, accept it from us
ربنا امنحنا الملك: Our Lord, grant us a kingdom
ربنا أعطنا قصرًا: Our Lord, give us a palace
They prayed for acceptance and that Allah make them Muslims submitting to Him.
بماذا وصف الله إسماعيل في القرآن؟: How did Allah describe Isma'il in the Qur'an?
قال تعالى: ﴿إِنَّهُ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَع: Allah Almighty says: "Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet."
ما أول بيت وُضع للناس للعبادة؟: What was the first house established for people to worship in?
رتّب أحداث القصة: Order the events of the story
إسكان هاجر وإسماعيل بمكة: Settling Hajar and Isma'il in Makkah
الأذان بالحج في الناس: The call to Hajj among the people
أمر الله إبراهيم أن يؤذّن في الناس بالحج: Allah commanded Ibrahim to announce the Hajj among the people.
لوط وشعيب عليهما السلام: Lut and Shu'ayb (peace be upon them)
إلى أي قوم أُرسل لوط عليه السلام؟: To which people was Lut (peace be upon him) sent?
قومه في سدوم وما حولها: His people in Sodom and the surrounding area
They committed an immoral act that no one before them had done.
ما ذنب قوم لوط الأكبر؟: What was the greatest sin of Lut's people?
Lut rebuked them for it and commanded them to fear Allah.
قلب الله ديارهم وأمطرهم حجارة: Allah overturned their towns and rained stones upon them
Allah made the highest part of it the lowest.
من هلك مع قوم لوط من أهله؟: Which of his family perished with Lut's people?
كانت من الغابرين لأنها لم تكن على الإيما: She was among those who stayed behind because she was not a believer.
ما اسم قوم شعيب عليه السلام؟: What was the name of Shu'ayb's people (peace be upon him)?
Their brother Shu'ayb was sent to them.
ما الذنب المشهور لقوم شعيب مع عبادة غير: Besides worshipping others than Allah, what was the well-known sin of Shu'ayb's people?
قال لهم: ﴿أَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيزَا: He said to them: "Give full measure and weight in justice."
ماذا نهاهم شعيب أن يفعلوه بالطرقات؟: What did Shu'ayb forbid them from doing on the roads?
They used to sit on every path, threatening.
ماذا يقول الله عن من لم يوفِ الميزان؟: What does Allah say about those who do not give full measure?
ويل للمطففين: Woe to those who give less
This is mentioned at the beginning of Surah Al-Mutaffifin.
الدرس الأهم من قصة قوم شعيب؟: What is the most important lesson from the story of Shu'ayb's people?
Islam commands justice in buying and selling.
رتّب خطوات دعوة شعيب لقومه: Order the steps of Shu'ayb's call to his people
الأمر بعبادة الله وحده: The command to worship Allah alone
النهي عن التطفيف: The prohibition of cheating in measure
Allah saved Shu'ayb and those who believed with him.
ما اسم أبي يوسف عليه السلام؟: What is the name of Yusuf's father (peace be upon him)?
يعقوب هو ابن إسحاق وحفيد إبراهيم عليهم ا: Ya'qub is the son of Ishaq and the grandson of Ibrahim (peace be upon them).
ماذا رأى يوسف في منامه وهو صغير؟: What did Yusuf see in his dream when he was young?
أحد عشر كوكبًا والشمس والقمر ساجدين له: Eleven stars, and the sun and moon, prostrating to him
أنه يحمل جبلًا: That he was carrying a mountain
قال له أبوه: لا تقصص رؤياك على إخوتك فيك: His father told him: Do not tell your dream to your brothers, or they will plot against you.
ماذا فعل إخوة يوسف به؟: What did Yusuf's brothers do to him?
ألقوه في الجُبّ: They threw him into the well
باعوه للملك: They sold him to the king
تركوه في الصحراء: They left him in the desert
They envied him for his father's love, so they threw him into the well.
من التقط يوسف من الجب؟: Who picked Yusuf up out of the well?
They sold him for a low price, a few dirhams.
كيف دخل يوسف السجن؟: How did Yusuf end up in prison?
ظلمًا بعد أن عفّ عن الفاحشة: Unjustly, after he refrained from immorality
قال: ﴿رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ﴾،: He said: "My Lord, prison is more beloved to me," and he preferred it over sin.
ما الذي ساعد يوسف على الخروج من السجن؟: What helped Yusuf get out of prison?
رأى الملك سبع بقرات سمان وسبعًا عجافًا،: The king saw seven fat cows and seven lean ones, and Yusuf interpreted it.
ماذا طلب يوسف بعد ذلك؟: What did Yusuf ask for afterward?
أن يتولى خزائن الأرض: To be put in charge of the land's storehouses
أن يعود لأبيه فقط: Only to return to his father
قال: ﴿اجْعَلْنِي عَلَىٰ خَزَائِنِ الْأَر: He said: "Appoint me over the storehouses of the land; I am a knowing guardian."
ماذا قال يوسف لإخوته عندما عرفهم؟: What did Yusuf say to his brothers when he recognized them?
لا تثريب عليكم اليوم: No blame will be upon you today
He forgave them, becoming a model of forgiveness.
بإلقاء قميص يوسف على وجهه: By Yusuf's shirt being cast over his face
Allah Almighty says: "He regained his sight."
رتّب أحداث قصة يوسف: Order the events of Yusuf's story
أيوب ويونس عليهما السلام: Ayyub and Yunus (peace be upon them)
بماذا اشتُهر أيوب عليه السلام؟: What was Ayyub (peace be upon him) known for?
قال تعالى: ﴿إِنَّا وَجَدْنَاهُ صَابِرًا: Allah Almighty says: "Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant."
بماذا ابتلاه الله؟: With what did Allah test him?
بالمرض وفقد المال والأهل: Illness and the loss of wealth and family
He was patient and complained only to Allah.
ماذا دعا أيوب ربه؟: What did Ayyub call upon his Lord with?
أني مسّني الضر وأنت أرحم الراحمين: That harm has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful
ربّ أعطني ملكًا: My Lord, give me a kingdom
دعا بأدب دون أن يطلب صراحة، فاستجاب الله: He prayed politely without asking outright, and Allah answered him.
بأمره أن يركض برجله ويغتسل ويشرب: By commanding him to strike the ground with his foot, wash and drink
بهجرته إلى مدينة: By his migration to a city
قال: ﴿ارْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَ: He said: "Strike the ground with your foot; this is a cool bath and drink."
الدرس الأساسي من قصة أيوب؟: What is the main lesson of the story of Job?
الصبر والرجاء في الله عند البلاء: Patience and hope in Allah during hardship
Allah tests His servants, then compensates them.
إلى أي قوم أُرسل يونس عليه السلام؟: To which people was Jonah (peace be upon him) sent?
أُرسل إلى أكثر من مئة ألف: He was sent to more than a hundred thousand
قال تعالى: ﴿وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ مِائَ: Allah the Most High said: “And We sent him to a hundred thousand [people] or more.”
ماذا فعل يونس عندما لم يؤمن قومه؟: What did Jonah do when his people did not believe?
ذهب مغاضبًا دون إذن ربه: He left in anger without his Lord's permission
دعا عليهم بالطوفان: He prayed against them to be struck by a flood
He left his people before Allah permitted him.
ماذا حدث ليونس في البحر؟: What happened to Jonah at sea?
He was thrown into the sea and the whale swallowed him while he was blameworthy.
بماذا دعا يونس في بطن الحوت؟: What did Jonah call out in the belly of the whale?
لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمي: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers
اللهم انصرني بالريح: O Allah, help me with the wind
سبحان الله العظيم فقط: Only “Glory be to Allah, the Almighty”
قال تعالى: ﴿فَنَادَىٰ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ أ: Allah the Most High said: “And he called out within the darknesses, ‘There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.’”
رتّب أحداث قصة يونس: Put the events of Jonah's story in order
ثم آمن قومه كلهم، وهم القوم الوحيدون الذ: Then all of his people believed. They were the only people whose faith benefited them when they saw the punishment.
ماذا كان فرعون يفعل بالمواليد من بني إسر: What did Pharaoh do to the newborns of the Children of Israel?
يقتل الذكور ويستحيي النساء: He killed the boys and spared the women
He was one of the corrupters who were arrogant in the land.
ماذا أوحى الله إلى أم موسى؟: What did Allah inspire to the mother of Moses?
أن ترضعه ثم تلقيه في اليمّ: To nurse him, then cast him into the river
أن تهرب به إلى الجبل: To flee with him to the mountain
ووعدها الله أن يردّه إليها ويجعله من الم: And Allah promised her that He would return him to her and make him one of the messengers.
من التقط موسى من النهر؟: Who picked Moses up out of the river?
قالت امرأة فرعون: قرّة عين لي ولك لا تقت: Pharaoh's wife said: “A comfort of the eye for me and for you. Do not kill him.”
كيف عاد موسى إلى أمه؟: How did Moses return to his mother?
منع الله عنه المراضع ودلّتهم أخته: Allah kept the nursing women from him, and his sister guided them
قال تعالى: ﴿فَرَجَعْنَاكَ إِلَىٰ أُمِّكَ: Allah the Most High said: “So We restored you to your mother that her eye might be comforted.”
ماذا حدث عندما وكز موسى رجلًا من عدوه؟: What happened when Moses struck a man from his enemy?
Moses felt regret and asked his Lord for forgiveness, and He forgave him.
خرج خائفًا يترقّب، وقال: ﴿عَسَىٰ رَبِّي: He left fearful and watchful, and said: “Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way.”
ماذا فعل موسى عند ماء مدين؟: What did Moses do at the water of Madyan?
سقى للمرأتين غنمهما: He watered the flock for the two women
ثم دعا: ﴿رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِ: Then he prayed: “My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.”
ماذا قال أبو المرأتين عن موسى؟: What did the father of the two women say about Moses?
إن خير من استأجرت القوي الأمين: The best one you can hire is the strong and trustworthy
إنه غريب لا نحتاجه: He is a stranger we do not need
قالتها إحدى المرأتين، وزوّجه أحدهما بعد: One of the two women said it, and one of them was given to him in marriage after the work.
ماذا رأى موسى عند عودته من مدين؟: What did Moses see on his way back from Madyan?
نارًا عند جانب الطور: A fire on the side of the mountain (At-Tur)
He went to bring a burning brand, and Allah spoke to him.
رتّب أحداث موسى الأولى: Put the early events of Moses in order
التقاط آل فرعون له: The family of Pharaoh picking him up
تكليم الله له عند الطور: Allah speaking to him at At-Tur
Then Allah sent him to Pharaoh.
مع من أرسل الله موسى إلى فرعون؟: Who did Allah send with Moses to Pharaoh?
Moses asked his Lord to make Aaron a helper for him.
أنه الرب الأعلى: That he was the most exalted lord
أنه ملك الجن: That he was the king of the jinn
أنه خادم الله: That he was a servant of Allah
He said: “I am your most exalted lord.”
ما الآيتان اللتان أراهما الله موسى أولًا: What were the two signs that Allah first showed Moses?
العصا واليد البيضاء: The staff and the white hand
حوّل العصا إلى حية وأخرج يده بيضاء من غي: He turned the staff into a snake and brought out his hand white, without any harm.
ماذا فعل السحرة عندما رأوا العصا تبتلع م: What did the magicians do when they saw the staff swallow what they had made?
آمنوا وخرّوا ساجدين: They believed and fell down in prostration
They said: We believe in the Lord of the worlds, the Lord of Moses and Aaron.
ماذا فعل فرعون بالسحرة المؤمنين؟: What did Pharaoh do to the believing magicians?
هددهم بالقتل والصلب: He threatened them with death and crucifixion
طردهم من البلد: He expelled them from the country
But they remained firm in their faith.
أن يسري بعباده ليلًا: To set out with His servants by night
خرج موسى ببني إسرائيل ليلًا فلحقهم فرعون: Moses left with the Children of Israel by night, and Pharaoh pursued them.
ماذا حدث لما وصلوا البحر وأدركهم فرعون؟: What happened when they reached the sea and Pharaoh caught up with them?
ضرب موسى البحر بعصاه فانفلق: Moses struck the sea with his staff and it split
Each part became like a great mountain.
ماذا حلّ بفرعون وجنوده؟: What happened to Pharaoh and his soldiers?
أُغرقوا في البحر: They were drowned in the sea
So Allah saved Moses and those with him, and drowned the others.
ماذا قال فرعون عند الغرق، ولماذا لم يُقب: What did Pharaoh say as he was drowning, and why was it not accepted?
أعلن الإيمان بعد فوات الأوان: He declared faith when it was too late
طلب النجدة من قومه: He asked his people for help
قال تعالى: ﴿آلْآنَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْل: Allah the Most High said: “Now? And you had disobeyed before.”
رتّب أحداث موسى مع فرعون: Put the events of Moses and Pharaoh in order
انفلاق البحر وغرق فرعون: The sea splitting and Pharaoh drowning
Allah made Pharaoh's body a sign for people.
داود وسليمان عليهما السلام: David and Solomon (peace be upon them)
ما الكتاب الذي أُنزل على داود عليه السلا: What book was revealed to David (peace be upon him)?
من قتل داود عليه السلام في المعركة؟: Whom did David (peace be upon him) kill in battle?
قتل داود جالوت بإذن الله، وآتاه الله الم: David killed Goliath by Allah's permission, and Allah gave him kingship and wisdom.
ماذا ألان الله لداود؟: What did Allah soften for David?
He taught him the making of armor, and he ate from the work of his own hands.
ماذا كانت تفعل الجبال والطير مع داود؟: What did the mountains and the birds do with David?
تسبّح معه: They glorified Allah along with him
Allah made the mountains and the birds glorify Him along with David.
من هو ابن داود الذي ورث الملك والنبوة؟: Who is the son of David who inherited kingship and prophethood?
قال تعالى: ﴿وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُود: Allah the Most High said: “And Solomon inherited David.”
He said: “We have been taught the language of birds.”
ماذا سخّر الله لسليمان؟: What did Allah subject to Solomon?
The jinn worked for him whatever he wished, by Allah's permission.
ماذا قالت النملة لقومها؟: What did the ant say to her people?
ادخلوا مساكنكم لا يحطمنكم سليمان وجنوده: Enter your dwellings, lest Solomon and his soldiers crush you
So Solomon smiled, amused at her speech, and thanked his Lord.
من الطائر الذي جاء سليمان بخبر سبأ؟: Which bird brought Solomon news of Sheba?
It told him about a queen ruling a people who prostrated to the sun.
رتّب أحداث قصة سليمان مع سبأ: Put the events of Solomon's story with Sheba in order
وصول خبر القوم: The news of the people arriving
She said: I have submitted with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
من هي أم عيسى عليه السلام؟: Who is the mother of Jesus (peace be upon him)?
Mary, daughter of Imran, and there is a Surah in the Qur'an named after her.
من كفل مريم في المحراب؟: Who took care of Mary in the sanctuary?
كان يجد عندها رزقًا في كل مرة يدخل عليها: Every time he entered upon her, he would find provision with her.
ماذا طلب زكريا من ربه؟: What did Zechariah ask of his Lord?
ولدًا يرثه: A son to inherit from him

ماذا قال النبي ﷺ عن أمر المؤمن؟: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about the affair of the believer?
كله خير، إن أصابته سراء شكر وإن أصابته ض: All of it is good: if good times come he is grateful, and if hardship comes he is patient
كله ضيق وهمّ: All of it is hardship and worry
لا شأن له بالقدر: He has no concern with destiny
الحديث رواه مسلم، وفيه الجمع بين الشكر و: This Hadith was narrated by Muslim, and it combines gratitude and patience.
بالقلب واللسان والعمل بالطاعة: With the heart, the tongue, and acts of obedience
باللسان فقط دون عمل: With the tongue only, without action
بالقلب دون لسان: With the heart without the tongue
الشكر اعتراف بالنعمة واستعمالها في طاعة: Gratitude is acknowledging a blessing and using it in obedience to the Giver.
وعد الله الشاكرين بالزيادة في النعم والخ: Allah promised the grateful an increase in blessings and good.
ما معنى التوكل على الله؟: What does it mean to trust in Allah (tawakkul)?
الاعتماد على الله مع الأخذ بالأسباب: Relying on Allah while taking the means
ترك الأسباب والجلوس: Leaving the means and sitting back
قال ﷺ للأعرابي: «اعقلها وتوكل» أي خذ بال: The Prophet ﷺ said to the Bedouin: “Tie it, then rely on Allah,” meaning take the means, then trust.
طالب اجتهد في المذاكرة ثم رسب، فما موقفه: A student studied hard but failed. What is his right attitude?
يصبر ويحاول من جديد ويرضى بقدر الله: He is patient, tries again, and accepts Allah's decree
المؤمن يأخذ بالأسباب ثم يرضى بما قدّره ا: The believer takes the means, then accepts what Allah decreed and tries again.
قال تعالى: ﴿وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَ: Allah says: ﴿And whoever relies upon Allah …﴾
فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ: then He is sufficient for him
فَلَا يَتَعَبُ: then he will not get tired
فَيَكْفِيهِ النَّاسُ: then people will be enough for him
من توكل على الله كفاه، وهو سبحانه حسبه و: Whoever relies on Allah, He is enough for him, and He is his Protector.
أيّ مما يلي صورة من صور شكر نعمة الصحة؟: Which of these is a way of thanking Allah for the blessing of health?
استعمالها في الطاعة ونفع الناس: Using it in obedience and to benefit people
نعمة الصحة تُشكر بحسن استعمالها فيما يرض: The blessing of health is thanked by using it well in what pleases Allah.
رتّب خطوات التوكل الصحيح: Put the steps of proper trust in Allah in order
التوكل يجمع بين العمل والاعتماد على الله: Trust in Allah combines effort, relying on Allah, and accepting His decree.
المخارج والصفات والتفخيم: Points of articulation, characteristics, and heavy letters
ما عدد المخارج العامة للحروف؟: How many general points of articulation do the letters have?
هي: الجوف والحلق واللسان والشفتان والخيش: They are: the oral cavity, the throat, the tongue, the two lips, and the nasal cavity.
كم عدد حروف الحلق؟: How many throat letters are there?
They are: ء هـ ع ح غ خ.
أيّ الحروف التالية يخرج من الشفتين؟: Which of these letters comes out from the lips?
الباء والميم والواو من الشفتين، والفاء م: Ba, Meem and Waw come from the two lips, and Fa comes from the lower lip with the tips of the upper front teeth.
من أين تخرج الغنة؟: Where does the Ghunnah come from?
الغنة صوت يخرج من الخيشوم وهو أعلى الأنف: The Ghunnah is a sound that comes from the nasal cavity, the upper part of the nose.
ء هـ ع ح غ خ: ء هـ ع ح غ خ
ي ر م ل و ن: ي ر م ل و ن
تجمعها عبارة: قُطْبُ جَدٍّ، وهي اضطراب ا: They are gathered in the phrase: Qutbu Jadd. It is a vibration of the sound when the letter is silent.
ما حكم اللام في لفظ الجلالة في «قَالَ ال: What is the rule for the Lam in the name of Allah in «قَالَ اللَّهُ»?
تفخّم لام اسم الله إذا سبقها فتح أو ضم،: The Lam in the name of Allah is pronounced heavy after a Fathah or Dammah, and light after a Kasrah.
ما حكم اللام في لفظ الجلالة في «بِسْمِ ا: What is the rule for the Lam in the name of Allah in «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ»?
Because a Kasrah comes before it, so it is pronounced light.
الراء المكسورة مثل «رِزْقًا» تُنطق …: A Ra with a Kasrah, like in «رِزْقًا», is pronounced …
الراء المكسورة ترقق في الأصل، والمفتوحة: A Ra with a Kasrah is light by default, while a Ra with a Fathah or Dammah is heavy.
كم عدد حروف الاستعلاء وهي حروف التفخيم؟: How many elevation letters (Isti’la’), which are the heavy letters, are there?
They are gathered in: Khuss Daghtin Qiz.
رتّب المخارج العامة من الداخل إلى الخارج: Arrange the general articulation points from the inside to the outside
تبدأ المخارج من الجوف ثم الحلق ثم اللسان: The articulation points start from the oral cavity, then the throat, then the tongue, then the lips, and the nasal cavity is for the Ghunnah.
كم عدد أحكام النون الساكنة والتنوين؟: How many rules are there for Noon Sakinah and Tanween?
ما حروف الإظهار؟: What are the letters of Izhar?
ت ث ج د ذ ز: ت ث ج د ذ ز
They are the six throat letters.
ما حروف الإدغام؟: What are the letters of Idgham?
ي ر م ل و ن (يرملون): ي ر م ل و ن (Yarmaloon)
They are gathered in the word: Yarmaloon.
ما حرف الإقلاب؟: What is the letter of Iqlab?
تقلب النون أو التنوين ميمًا مخفاة مع غنة: The Noon or Tanween is turned into a hidden Meem with Ghunnah before the letter Ba.
كم حرفًا من حروف الإخفاء؟: How many letters of Ikhfa’ are there?
هي بقية الحروف: ص ذ ث ك ج ش ق س د ط ز ف: They are the remaining letters: ص ذ ث ك ج ش ق س د ط ز ف ت ض ظ.
ما حكم النون في «مِنْ بَعْدِ»؟: What is the rule for the Noon in «مِنْ بَعْدِ»?
It is a Noon Sakinah followed by a Ba.
ما حكم النون في «مَنْ آمَنَ»؟: What is the rule for the Noon in «مَنْ آمَنَ»?
A Hamzah comes after the Noon, and it is one of the throat letters.
ما حكم النون في «مِن رَّبِّهِمْ»؟: What is the rule for the Noon in «مِن رَّبِّهِمْ»?
Ra and Lam are merged into without Ghunnah.
ما حكم النون في «مَن يَقُولُ»؟: What is the rule for the Noon in «مَن يَقُولُ»?
Ya is one of the letters of Yarmaloon and is merged into with Ghunnah.
رتّب أحكام النون الساكنة والتنوين كما يُ: Arrange the rules of Noon Sakinah and Tanween as they are usually taught
This is the usual order in Tajweed books.
كم عدد أحكام الميم الساكنة؟: How many rules are there for Meem Sakinah?
إخفاء شفوي، وإدغام مثلين صغير، وإظهار شف: Labial Ikhfa’, Idgham of two identical letters (small), and labial Izhar.
ما حرف الإخفاء الشفوي؟: What is the letter of labial Ikhfa’?
Meem Sakinah is hidden before Ba with Ghunnah.
ما حكم الميم في «تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ»: What is the rule for the Meem in «تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ»?
A Meem Sakinah followed by a Ba.
ما حكم الميم في «لَهُم مَّا»؟: What is the rule for the Meem in «لَهُم مَّا»?
إدغام مثلين صغير: Small Idgham of two identical letters
A Meem Sakinah followed by a Meem with a vowel.
ما حكم الميم في «هُمْ فِيهَا»؟: What is the rule for the Meem in «هُمْ فِيهَا»?
يظهر ما بعد الميم لأنه حرف غير الباء وال: The letter after the Meem is pronounced clearly because it is a letter other than Ba and Meem.
عند أي الحروف يكون الإظهار الشفوي أشد؟: Before which letters is labial Izhar strongest?
يجب الحذر من إخفاء الميم قبلهما، مثل: «ع: Be careful not to hide the Meem before them, as in: «عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا».
كم حركة تُمدّ غنة الميم المشددة؟: How many counts is the Ghunnah of a doubled Meem held?
الغنة في الميم والنون المشددتين مقدارها: The Ghunnah in a doubled Meem and Noon lasts two counts.
ما حكم الميم في «أَمْ لَمْ»؟: What is the rule for the Meem in «أَمْ لَمْ»?
وبعدها ميم في «لَمْ» فتُدغم في الميم بعد: It is followed by a Meem in «لَمْ», so it is merged into the Meem after it.
ما حكم الميم في «إِنَّهُم بِهِمْ»؟: What is the rule for the Meem in «إِنَّهُم بِهِمْ»?
A Meem Sakinah followed by the letter Ba.
رتّب أحكام الميم الساكنة: Arrange the rules of Meem Sakinah
كم حركة يُمدّ المد الطبيعي؟: How many counts is the natural Madd held?
المد الطبيعي لا يتوقف على سبب كهمز أو سك: The natural Madd does not depend on a cause such as a Hamzah or a Sukoon.
ما حروف المد؟: What are the letters of Madd?
الألف والواو والياء الساكنتان بشروط: Alif, Waw and Ya when silent, under conditions
الألف الساكنة بعد فتح، والواو الساكنة بع: A silent Alif after a Fathah, a silent Waw after a Dammah, and a silent Ya after a Kasrah.
إذا جاءت الهمزة بعد حرف المد في كلمة واح: When the Hamzah comes after the Madd letter in the same word
إذا جاءت الهمزة في كلمة تالية: When the Hamzah comes in the following word
إذا جاء بعده سكون أصلي: When a basic Sukoon comes after it
ما حكم المد المتصل؟: What is the ruling on the connected Madd?
The reciters agreed that it must be elongated.
كم حركة يُمدّ المتصل في القراءة المعروفة: How many counts is the connected Madd held in the well-known recitation of Hafs?
المشهور في رواية حفص من طريق الشاطبية: أ: The well-known view in Hafs’s narration through Ash-Shatibiyyah is: four or five.
حرف مد في آخر كلمة وهمزة في أول الكلمة ا: A Madd letter at the end of a word and a Hamzah at the start of the next word
همزة بعد مد في كلمة واحدة: A Hamzah after a Madd in one word
سكون أصلي بعد مد: A basic Sukoon after a Madd
مد يأتي عند الوقف فقط: A Madd that occurs only when stopping
ما حكم المد المنفصل؟: What is the ruling on the separated Madd?
سمّي جائزًا لجواز قصره عند بعض القراء، و: It is called permissible because some reciters allow shortening it, and in Hafs it is held four or five counts.
إذا جاء بعد حرف المد سكون أصلي: When a basic Sukoon comes after the Madd letter
إذا جاءت بعده همزة: When a Hamzah comes after it
إذا جاء في آخر السورة فقط: When it comes at the end of a Surah only
إذا كان حرف المد مفتوحًا: When the Madd letter has a Fathah
Like: «الضَّالِّينَ», and it is held six counts.
كم حركة يُمدّ المد اللازم؟: How many counts is the obligatory Madd held?
The reciters agreed to hold it six counts.
رتّب أنواع المد من الأقصر إلى الأطول مقد: Arrange the types of Madd from the shortest to the longest in length
الطبيعي حركتان، المنفصل والمتصل أربع أو: The natural is two counts, the separated and connected are four or five, and the obligatory is six.
قطع الصوت عن الكلمة زمنًا يتنفس فيه القا: Cutting off the sound on a word for a time in which the reciter breathes
Stopping is done with the intention of resuming the recitation afterwards.
ماذا تعني علامة «م» في المصحف؟: What does the sign «م» in the Mushaf mean?
It is preferable to stop there so that the meaning does not change.
ماذا تعني علامة «لا» في المصحف؟: What does the sign «لا» in the Mushaf mean?
ليس المقصود أنه حرام في كل الأحوال بل ين: It does not mean it is forbidden in every case, but one should not stop there.
Stopping and continuing are both permitted.
الوقف أولى مع جواز الوصل: Stopping is better, while continuing is permitted
It is preferable to stop at this sign.
الوصل أولى مع جواز الوقف: Continuing is better, while stopping is permitted
It is preferable to continue there.
الشروع في القراءة بعد قطع أو وقف: Beginning the recitation after a break or a stop
ينبغي أن يبتدئ القارئ بمكان يصحّ فيه الم: The reciter should start at a place where the meaning is sound.
كيف يوقف على التاء المربوطة مثل «رَحْمَة: How do you stop on a Ta Marbutah like in «رَحْمَةٌ»?
You stop on it as a Ha, so you say: Rahmah.
كيف يوقف على الاسم المنون المنصوب مثل «ع: How do you stop on an accusative word with Tanween like «عَلِيمًا»?
The two Fathahs are replaced by an Alif when stopping.
رتّب خطوات القارئ عند علامة وقف: Arrange the reciter’s steps at a stop sign
يسكّن آخر الكلمة: He makes the end of the word silent
يبدأ بما يصحّ معناه: He starts with what makes sense
الوقف يكون على السكون وبعد التنفس ثم الا: Stopping is done on a Sukoon and after breathing, then starting where the meaning is sound.
ما موضوع حديث «إنما الأعمال بالنيات»؟: What is the topic of the Hadith «Actions are only by intentions»?
أهمية النية في صحة العمل وقبوله: The importance of intention for an action to be sound and accepted
It is the first Hadith in the Forty Hadith of an-Nawawi.
من راوي حديث «إنما الأعمال بالنيات»؟: Who narrated the Hadith «Actions are only by intentions»?
Umar narrated it from the pulpit. Agreed upon (Bukhari & Muslim).
أكمل: «إنما الأعمال بالنيات وإنما لكل ام: Complete: «Actions are only by intentions, and every person will only have …»
Every person is rewarded according to his intention.
أي حديث فيه أركان الإسلام والإيمان والإح: Which Hadith contains the pillars of Islam, faith and excellence (Ihsan)?
جاء جبريل عليه السلام في صورة رجل يسأل ا: Jibreel (peace be upon him) came in the form of a man and asked the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
كم أركان الإسلام في حديث «بُني الإسلام ع: How many pillars of Islam are there in the Hadith «Islam is built upon five»?
الشهادتان، والصلاة، والزكاة، والحج، وصوم: The two testimonies of faith, prayer, Zakat, Hajj, and fasting Ramadan.
من راوي حديث «بني الإسلام على خمس»؟: Who narrated the Hadith «Islam is built upon five»?
ما حكم من أحدث في الدين ما ليس منه؟: What is the ruling on someone who introduces into the religion something that is not part of it?
قال ﷺ: «من أحدث في أمرنا هذا ما ليس منه: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said: «Whoever introduces into this matter of ours something that is not part of it, it is rejected», from the Hadith of Aisha.
ما معنى «الحلال بيّن والحرام بيّن»؟: What is the meaning of «The lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear»?
أن أمور الحلال والحرام واضحة وبينهما أمو: That matters of the lawful and the unlawful are clear, and between them are doubtful matters
من اتقى الشبهات استبرأ لدينه وعرضه، والر: Whoever avoids doubtful matters has protected his religion and his honor. The narrator is An-Nu'man ibn Bashir.
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ في حديث تميم الداري؟: What did the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ say in the hadith of Tamim ad-Dari?
الدين المعاملة فقط: Religion is only dealing with others
النصيحة لله ولكتابه ولرسوله ولأئمة المسل: Sincere advice is for Allah, for His Book, for His Messenger, and for the leaders of the Muslims and their common people.
رتّب أسئلة جبريل في حديثه المشهور: Put Jibril's questions in order from his famous hadith
سأل جبريل عن الإسلام ثم الإيمان ثم الإحس: Jibril asked about Islam, then Iman (faith), then Ihsan (excellence), then the Hour.
The narrator is Anas ibn Malik, and the hadith is agreed upon (Bukhari & Muslim).
ما الدرس الرئيس في حديث «لا يؤمن أحدكم ح: What is the main lesson of the hadith “None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother”?
كمال الإيمان بمحبة الخير للناس: Perfecting faith by wishing good for people
المؤمن يحب لإخوانه من الخير ما يحب لنفسه: A believer loves for his brothers the good that he loves for himself.
ماذا يفعل من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر: According to the hadith, what does the one who believes in Allah and the Last Day do?
يقول خيرًا أو يصمت: Says something good or stays silent
رواه أبو هريرة، وفيه إكرام الجار والضيف: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah. It also mentions honoring the neighbor and the guest.
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ لمن طلب الوصية؟: What did the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ say to the one who asked for advice?
He repeated it several times. Narrated by Bukhari from Abu Hurayrah.
ما معنى «لا تغضب»؟: What does “Do not get angry” mean?
لا تنفّذ مقتضى الغضب من الأذى والإساءة: Do not act on anger by harming or mistreating others
المقصود ضبط النفس عند الغضب وتجنب أسبابه: It means controlling yourself when angry and avoiding its causes.
ما موضوع حديث «إن الله كتب الإحسان على ك: What is the topic of the hadith “Indeed, Allah has prescribed excellence in everything”?
Narrated by Muslim from Shaddad ibn Aws.
أكمل: «دع ما يريبك إلى …»: Complete: “Leave what makes you doubt for …”
ما لا يريبك: what does not make you doubt
الحديث عن الحسن بن علي، وفيه ترك الشك إل: The hadith is from al-Hasan ibn Ali; it tells us to leave doubt for certainty.
أكمل: «من حسن إسلام المرء تركه …»: Complete: “Part of the excellence of a person's Islam is his leaving …”
The hadith is from Abu Hurayrah; it speaks of leaving nosiness.
سمعت أن زميلك يتحدث عن أمر لا يخصك، فما: You heard that your classmate is talking about something that is none of your business. Which is closest to the hadith “what does not concern him”?
لا أتدخل فيما لا يعنيني: I do not get involved in what does not concern me
أنقل الكلام للآخرين: I pass the words on to others
Leaving nosiness is part of the perfection of Islam.
رتّب خطوات الإحسان في الذبح كما في الحدي: Put the steps of excellence in slaughtering in order, as in the hadith
الحديث فيه الأمر بإحسان الذبحة وإراحة ال: The hadith commands doing the slaughter well and giving the animal ease.
وصايا للقلب والسلوك: Counsels for the heart and conduct
The hadith is addressed to Abu Dharr and Mu'adh (may Allah be pleased with them both).
ما الذي يمحو السيئة كما في حديث «اتق الل: According to the hadith “Fear Allah wherever you are”, what wipes out a bad deed?
أن تتبعها بحسنة: Following it with a good deed
The Prophet ﷺ said: “And follow up a bad deed with a good deed, it will wipe it out.”
The hadith is from Abdullah ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both).
ما معنى «احفظ الله تجده تجاهك»؟: What does “Protect Allah and you will find Him before you” mean?
من حفظ حدود الله وجد عون الله: Whoever keeps Allah's limits finds Allah's help
من حفظ المال زاد غناه: Whoever keeps his money grows richer
Protecting Allah means obeying Him and avoiding disobedience to Him.
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ عن الطهور؟: What did the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ say about purification (Taharah)?
الراوي أبو مالك الأشعري، والحديث في صحيح: The narrator is Abu Malik al-Ash'ari, and the hadith is in Sahih Muslim.
ما معنى «الحمد لله تملأ الميزان»؟: What does “Alhamdulillah fills the scale” mean?
عظم ثواب الحمد: The greatness of the reward for praising Allah
الحمد يخص الأغنياء: Praising Allah is only for the rich
It comes in the same hadith, which mentions the virtue of Dhikr (remembrance of Allah).
ماذا تجاوز الله عنه لأمة محمد ﷺ؟: What did Allah overlook for the followers of Muhammad ﷺ?
الخطأ والنسيان وما استكرهوا عليه: Mistakes, forgetfulness, and what they are forced into
الحديث عن ابن عباس، ومعناه رفع الإثم عن: The hadith is from Ibn Abbas; it means sin is lifted for mistakes, forgetfulness, and coercion.
أكمل: «كن في الدنيا كأنك …»: Complete: “Be in this world as if you were …”
تاجر أو ثري: a merchant or a rich man
الراوي عبد الله بن عمر، وفيه الزهد في ال: The narrator is Abdullah ibn Umar; it speaks of detachment from this world.
ما معنى «لا ضرر ولا ضرار»؟: What does “There is no harm and no returning harm” mean?
لا يجوز إلحاق الأذى بالنفس ولا بالغير: It is not permitted to harm oneself or others
يجوز الأذى للمنفعة: Harm is allowed for the sake of benefit
يرويه أبو سعيد الخدري، وهو من القواعد ال: Narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; it is one of the great principles of Islamic law (Shariah).
رتّب النصائح الواردة في حديث «اتق الله ح: Put the pieces of advice from the hadith “Fear Allah wherever you are” in order
